Lexkite – English learning app (IELTS · TOEIC · TOEFL · CEFR) shipped in 15 UI languages incl. German, Russian, Vietnamese, Arabic (RTL): design every label for +40% longer text, wrap instead of truncating, never shrink buttons. Use the project design system (Lexkite Kit / Tactile Gamified Prep): Plus Jakarta Sans, deep teal #0F3D3E brand, coral CTA with tactile bottom ledge, cream light background, rounded 16-24px cards. App shell: mobile bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs Today, Vocab, Skills, Tests, Me; desktop left sidebar with the same 5 items. No hearts or lives anywhere. No photos and no drawn people: where the teacher appears, leave an empty rounded placeholder labelled "teacher-slot" (the 2D teacher Ama or Carlos is inserted by code). Material Symbols Rounded icons. Every tap target at least 44x44 px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1. Realistic content, no lorem ipsum.

Screen (mobile 390px, light theme): the IELTS Listening practice hub, an INNER screen (back arrow 44 px + title "Listening practice", no bottom tabs). A horizontally scrollable row of test tabs "Test 1 ✓", "Test 2", "Test 3", "Test 4" (Test 1 selected, a small check shows it was completed). One card "Test 1" with a "Band 7.0" chip and a full-width coral button "Full test · 40 questions". Inside, four part cards stacked: each shows a chip "Part 1 · Everyday conversation", title ("Joining a community sports centre"), small muted topic line ("Sport & leisure"), speaker chips with flag and name ("🇬🇧 Daniel", "🇬🇧 Joanna"), a "✓ 8/10" best-score chip on two of them, and three small actions: primary "Practice", secondary "Listen once", secondary "Dictation". Parts 2, 3, 4 titles: "A tour of the botanic garden" (Social monologue), "Planning a marine biology project" (Academic discussion), "The history of the bicycle" (Academic lecture). Below, a "Listening tips" card with 5 short bullet tips (read the questions first, beware of changed answers, paraphrase, word limits, 10 minutes of dictation a day). Feel: calm, focused, encouraging. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels. Frame (Lexkite §5d): phone 390 px; top bar is one of three fixed variants – hub screen: title left + one icon action right, with the 5 bottom tabs; inner screen: back arrow (44 px) + title, no bottom tabs; lesson/focus screen: close X (44 px) top left + slim progress bar, no tabs, one full-width primary button pinned at the bottom. 16 px side gutter, one primary button per screen.
